description: The night's wind over the old town: an ambience loop (the game's Wind.wav).
prompt: Eerie howling night wind around an old stone town, {variation}, ominous horror atmosphere, constant, no music, no voices, no birds.
variations: a hollow moaning wind whistling through gaps in wooden shutters
a deep mournful howl rising and falling
strange breathing gusts wailing round the corners
a low drone of wind with a ghostly whistle now and then
feedback: 2026-11-28 owner: wanted more wailing, horror-like; prompts now ask for howling, moaning and an ominous mood
